Keystone’s roadmap discusses future archive changes but does not authorize a retention period different from current customer policy.
Effective immediately, the customer compliance addendum superseded the earlier policy and requires at least 90 days of audit-export retention; the earlier 30-day requirement is no longer current.
The project explicitly changed retention from 30 to 90 days to comply with the new addendum, superseding its prior 30-day decision; the change ticket updated the configuration accordingly.
